args.code: (() => { const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('button,a,input')]; const target = els.find(b => (b.innerText||b.value||'').includes('Tambah Karyawan')); if (!target) return JSON.stringify({found:false, all: els.map(b=>({t:b.tagName, text:(b.innerText||b.value||'').trim().slice(0,40), type:b.type})).filter(x=>x.text).slice(0,30)}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({found:true, clicked: (target.innerText||target.value||'').trim(), tag:target.tagName, type:target.type||null}); })()
